value.body: A digital marketing specialist runs a brand's online marketing across search, social media, email and paid ads. Employers include digital agencies, e-commerce and consumer brands, startups and edtech firms. A typical day involves planning and running campaigns, tracking results in analytics tools, and adjusting budgets and content.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: BBA, B.Com, B.A. or MBA; a digital marketing certificate is common

items.label: Common tools
items.value: Search and social ad platforms, web analytics, email tools, SEO tools

items.label: Key areas
items.value: SEO, paid ads, social media, email, analytics

items.label: Digital advertising in India
items.note: About 63% of all advertising revenue that year

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers usually start as digital marketing executives or interns at agencies, often after a short certification course from an ad platform or training institute. Running campaigns for a small business or personal project helps show results.

value.title: Skills you'll use
items: Running paid search and social ads

value.title: At a glance
items: Results are measured closely, so data skills matter.
Next roles: specialist lead, performance marketing manager, digital marketing manager.
Platforms change often; continuous learning is part of the job.
